_comment: Source of truth for the robotics learning task lists. Mirrors phases in robotics-plan.md. Each list becomes a Microsoft To Do list; each task becomes a To Do task with optional checklist subitems.

tasks.title: Set up WSL2 + Ubuntu + ROS 2 Jazzy
tasks.notes: One-time environment install. Plan: https://aviadezra-hue.github.io/robotics-plan/#%F0%9F%9B%A0%EF%B8%8F-phase-0--environment-setup
subitems: Update apt and install build essentials
Add ROS 2 apt repo and key
Install Windows Terminal + VcXsrv (or WSLg) for GUI apps
Run turtlesim_node and confirm window appears

tasks.title: Step 1 — Create your ROS 2 workspace (do this once)
tasks.notes: Plan: Phase 1 Step 1. Goal: have ~/ros2_ws built and sourced.

tasks.title: Step 2 — Explore the ROS 2 CLI with turtlesim
tasks.notes: Plan: Phase 1 Step 2. Goal: be fluent with ros2 node/topic/service/param/bag and remappings.
subitems: Spawn turtle2 + remap teleop to drive it

tasks.title: Step 3 — Write your first ROS 2 package (odom_demo mini-project)
tasks.notes: Plan: Phase 1 Step 3 (sub-steps 3.1–3.8). All commands relative to ~/ros2_ws/src.
subitems: 3.7  Wire setup.py entry_points + demo.launch.py + colcon build
3.8  ros2 launch odom_demo demo.launch.py + introspect + override params

tasks.title: 📊 Read the Phase 1 Internalization Deck (18 slides)
tasks.notes: Download: https://aviadezra-hue.github.io/robotics-plan/Phase1-ROS2-Internalize.pptx — concept-first, 15–20 min on the couch. Consolidates everything before Phase 2.
subitems: Topics deep + services & params + launch + bags

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 1 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: Build odom_demo, launch it, and confirm the topic streams cleanly with the subscriber logging computed velocities.
subitems: ros2 topic echo / hz on the demo topic

tasks.title: Step 1 — Install the TurtleBot 3 simulation stack
tasks.notes: sudo apt install ros-jazzy-turtlebot3* ros-jazzy-teleop-twist-keyboard
subitems: Confirm with `ros2 pkg list | grep turtlebot3`

tasks.title: Step 2 — Configure TURTLEBOT3_MODEL=burger in ~/.bashrc
tasks.notes: Persist the model env var so every new shell knows which robot to spawn.

tasks.title: Step 3 — Launch Gazebo + spawn the robot (empty world)
tasks.notes: ros2 launch turtlebot3_gazebo empty_world.launch.py
subitems: Confirm Gazebo opens with Burger on the floor

tasks.title: Step 4 — Drive it with keyboard teleop
tasks.notes: Terminal 2: ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard

tasks.title: Step 5 — Inspect /cmd_vel, /odom, /scan live
tasks.notes: Use Phase 1 CLI muscle memory on a real robot.

tasks.title: Step 6 — Visualize robot + lidar in RViz2
tasks.notes: Fixed Frame=odom; add RobotModel, TF, LaserScan(/scan).
subitems: Drive and confirm the scan tracks the robot

tasks.title: Step 7 — Drive through TurtleBot3 house + view_frames
tasks.notes: ros2 launch turtlebot3_gazebo turtlebot3_house.launch.py

tasks.title: Step 8 — Mini-project: sim_safety / front_distance_monitor node
tasks.notes: Subscribe to /scan, publish min front distance on /front_distance, WARN at <0.5 m.
subitems: 8.5  Run the node + drive toward a wall + watch WARN logs

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 2 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: Robot drives in Gazebo, RViz2 shows live lidar + TF, and front_distance_monitor warns when you approach a wall.
subitems: sim_safety logs WARN when close to wall

tasks.title: Step 1 — Install Nav2 + the simulated robot
tasks.notes: sudo apt install ros-jazzy-navigation2 ros-jazzy-nav2-bringup ros-jazzy-slam-toolbox
subitems: Confirm with `ros2 pkg list | grep nav2`

tasks.title: Step 2 — Launch the simulated world & meet the robot
tasks.notes: Bring up TurtleBot 3 in a known world for mapping.

tasks.title: Step 3 — Build a map with SLAM (slam_toolbox)
tasks.notes: Drive the robot to map the environment in real time.
subitems: Open RViz2 with the Nav2 config
Drive slowly with teleop to cover the world
Watch the occupancy grid fill in

tasks.title: Step 4 — Save the map to disk
tasks.notes: ros2 run nav2_map_server map_saver_cli -f ~/maps/my_map

tasks.title: Step 5 — Relaunch in localization mode (AMCL)
tasks.notes: Switch from SLAM to localization against the saved map.
subitems: Use 2D Pose Estimate in RViz2 to seed pose

tasks.title: Step 6 — Send a navigation goal from RViz2
tasks.notes: Use the Nav2 Goal tool to send the robot somewhere.

tasks.title: Step 7 — Send a goal from the CLI (no RViz)
tasks.notes: ros2 action send_goal /navigate_to_pose nav2_msgs/action/NavigateToPose ...
subitems: Send a goal via action send_goal
Observe feedback + result in the terminal

tasks.title: Step 8 — Inspect & tune Nav2
tasks.notes: Read params, tweak velocity / inflation / planner choices.

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 3 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: Map saved; robot relocalizes; autonomous nav to clicked goal completes without manual intervention.
subitems: Saved map opens cleanly in RViz2
AMCL converges from a 2D Pose Estimate
Robot navigates from A to B autonomously

tasks.title: Learn the 4 manipulation pillars
tasks.notes: Conceptual foundation before MoveIt practice.

tasks.title: Pick a simulated arm + run the MoveIt demo
tasks.notes: Panda or UR5 with MoveIt 2 in RViz.
subitems: Launch the MoveIt demo for the arm
Drag the IK marker; click Plan + Execute

tasks.title: Follow the 8-week roadmap (one task per week)
tasks.notes: Progress from kinematics → planning → grasping → custom robot.
subitems: W1: FK/IK math refresher + URDF basics
W2: MoveIt Setup Assistant on a stock arm
W3: Planning groups + end-effector + scene objects
W6: Perception → detect object → plan to grasp

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 4 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: End-to-end pick & place of a perceived object in simulation.
subitems: Object detection feeds a grasp pose
Object is placed at a different location

tasks.title: Pick your track + first physical robot
tasks.notes: Mobile (TurtleBot/Create 3), manipulator (Niryo/UFactory), or DIY.
subitems: Decide track: mobile, arm, or both

tasks.title: Israel-specific shipping & customs notes
tasks.notes: Plan ahead for VAT/customs and lithium battery shipping limits.
subitems: Set up a freight forwarder if needed

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 5 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: Hardware delivered, powered on, and pinged from your dev machine.
subitems: Network reachable from WSL2 / dev box

tasks.title: Bring up the real robot's ROS 2 stack
tasks.notes: Use the same nodes you exercised in simulation, on real hardware.
subitems: Bring up driver + URDF on the real robot

tasks.title: Port your Phase 2/3 code to the real robot
tasks.notes: Reuse sim_safety, mapping, and Nav2 launch files with hardware params.
subitems: Map the real room with slam_toolbox
Save map + run Nav2 in localization mode

tasks.title: ✅ Phase 6 validation checkpoint
tasks.notes: Real robot maps a real room and navigates autonomously to a clicked goal.
